summary: Training proxy backend + Training page frontend verified. 17/17 pytest tests pass; UI renders with live data and the lateness −3h shift is correctly applied.

issues: Recharts logs minor 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings during initial mount before chart container measures. Cosmetic only — charts render correctly afterwards (verified via screenshot).

critical_code_review_comments: Associate role behaviour: per current Vivo policy in server.py (_resolve_role + the upgrade-on-login block in /auth/session), every user is bumped to role='manager'. The seeded associate session therefore returns 200 on /training endpoints, not 403. This is expected per the request note. If 403 needs to be enforced for true associates, the upgrade block in /auth/session needs removal.
training.py uses Depends(require_manager) consistently — auth gating implementation is correct; the 'fail-open' is purely due to the policy described above.
_shift_lateness correctly walks dict/list and floors at 0; verified Quality Standards raw 10.45 → 7.45 and Odoo raw 10.54 → 7.54.
Frontend Training.jsx (~350 lines) is fine size-wise. The recharts warnings on first render could be suppressed by setting minWidth/minHeight on the chart containers.

rca of the issue: Bug 'attendance/lateness 3h ahead' caused by upstream computing (check_in_utc − training_start_local). Fixed in proxy via _shift_lateness recursively subtracting LATENESS_OFFSET_HOURS (default 3, clamped at 0) from any key containing 'lateness'. Verified end-to-end.
